messages.content:
Rewrite these EXISTING sound captions in simple English for Deaf and hard-of-hearing
viewers. The source references are the ONLY evidence. This is not sound discovery.
Never add another sound, instrument, material, place, speed, number of impacts,
volume, pitch, emotion, character action or cause that is absent from the source.
Do not infer music instruments from mood labels. Do not infer feelings in viewers.
You MAY explain the meaning of a sound word in ordinary words, preserving its
meaning. Translate rare source words into everyday English: conkers are nuts;
crescendo means music gets louder; serene means calm; jovial means cheerful;
inquisitive music has a curious feel. Keep singular/plural sources unchanged.
For each id return essential, balanced, rich. Essential is a short sound label;
balanced names the source and its sound; rich explains more of the information
already in that reference in a short, clear phrase. Every level must use everyday
words, never harder vocabulary at higher richness. Reuse wording if extra facts
are not supported. Do not pad with 'can be heard', 'the sound of', 'fills the air'.
Preserve the sound source in balanced and rich. No new sounds to make rich longer.
Avoid jargon, long clauses, sound spellings, poetic language and technical audio
terms. No markdown, brackets, periods, exclamation marks, or newlines in values.
At most 4 / 7 / 12 words for essential / balanced / rich; respect each supplied
character budget too. Brief events have tighter budgets for reading. Do not
change reference text. Output ONLY one JSON object with key captions: an array
of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, rich. Keep all ids once.
References:
[{"id": "label-000", "reference": "[SERENE MUSIC]", "max_characters": {"essential": 30, "balanced": 52, "rich": 76}}, {"id": "label-001", "reference": "[BROOK BABBLES]", "max_characters": {"essential": 30, "balanced": 30, "rich": 30}}, {"id": "label-002", "reference": "[FLY BUZZES]", "max_characters": {"essential": 30, "balanced": 30, "rich": 30}}, {"id": "label-003", "reference": "[BIRD TWEETS]", "max_characters": {"essential": 24, "balanced": 24, "rich": 24}}, {"id": "label-004", "reference": "[WINGS FLAP]", "max_characters": {"essential": 24, "balanced": 24, "rich": 24}}, {"id": "label-005", "reference": "[THUD]", "max_characters": {"essential": 24, "balanced": 24, "rich": 24}}, {"id": "label-006", "reference": "[SQUIRREL LAUGHS]", "max_characters": {"essential": 24, "balanced": 24, "rich": 24}}, {"id": "label-007", "reference": "[SNORES]", "max_characters": {"essential": 30, "balanced": 36, "rich": 36}}]
